We're looking for Product Managers responsible for creating amazing games and building the best experience for our users in collaboration with a talented team. If you are a passionate product manager who loves games and shares our passion for enjoying and crafting games, come and join us!

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

  • Iterate with A/B tests and come up with data-driven product decisions

  • Work on every aspect of your product such as brainstorming a new feature, releasing a new update or improving an animation in the game

  • Closely follow mobile game trends and gather market intelligence

  • Optimize and track monetization channels to improve LTV

YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics or relevant fields

  • 5+ years of relevant business experience

  • A good sense of gameplay experience and special attention to detail

  • Good analytical skills to make data-driven decisions 

  • Passionate about the startup environment

  • Being a collaborative team player

  • Experience with Excel and SQL is a big plus

We're looking for a Data Scientist who thrives on solving complex problems and uncovering insights that drive top-performing games. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with the Marketing, Development, and Product teams to analyze player behaviour, optimize game performance, and turn data into actionable strategies. Your expertise in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization will play a key role in shaping our games and enhancing player experiences.

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field from a recognized university.

  • 2+ years of experience in data science, preferably in gaming or tech.

  • Expertise in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualization.

  • Proficiency in Python

  • Strong analytical mindset with a sharp eye for detail and problem-solving.

  • Excellent communication skills, capable of translating complex data into actionable insights for non-technical teams.

  • Passion for gaming, with a deep understanding of player behaviour and game mechanics.

YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

  • Extract insights from large datasets to identify trends and opportunities.

  • Develop and implement data models and machine learning algorithms to enhance game performance and player experience.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate data-driven strategies into game development and decision-making.

  • Design and execute A/B tests to measure the impact of new features and optimizations.

  • Monitor and refine in-game metrics to maximize player satisfaction and retention.

  • Translate data into action, providing strategic recommendations to improve engagement and monetization.

We're looking for a passionate and creative 2D Game Animator who will be producing high-quality 2D game animation for our chart-topping games. You will be responsible for creating all game and character animations utilising your imagination and visualisation skills. As a part of the Bigger team, you will be working closely with our game artists and game developers to architect outstanding gaming experiences that reach millions of players all around the world.
If you are a talented 2D Game Animator who loves games and shares our passion for enjoying and crafting games, come and join us!

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

  • Create high-quality 2D animations for characters, environments, UI, and visual effects.

  • Translate game concepts and storyboards into expressive animations that fit the Kitchen Masters' style.

  • Work with the art, product and development teams to ensure animations align with gameplay and technical requirements.

  • Optimize animations for mobile platforms while maintaining visual quality.

  • Contribute creative ideas for improving animation workflows and visual storytelling.

  • Ensure consistency and maintain the visual identity of the project.

YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Animation, Graphics Design or relevant fields

  • Experience as a 2D Animator, preferably in the gaming industry.

  • Proficiency in animation software such as Spine, After Effects, Toon Boom, or equivalent.

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, timing, and motion dynamics.

  • Experience creating sprite sheets and implementing animations into Unity game engine.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Strong knowledge of Particle System to be able to create high quality VFX.

  • 5+ years of industry experience is a plus

ABOUT BIGGER GAMES
We're looking for a Level Designer who will grow with the challenges of chart-topping games. At Bigger, Level Designers combine creativity, player understanding, and data to craft engaging experiences that keep millions of players challenged and entertained.
You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Game Developers, and Game Artists to create, test, and continuously improve levels while shaping the overall player experience.
If you are a passionate Level Designer who loves puzzle games, enjoys understanding what makes a level fun, and shares our passion for playing and crafting great games, come and join us!


ABOUT THIS ROLE:

  • Design, build, test, and continuously improve engaging levels for our games

  • Balance difficulty and progression to create a smooth, challenging, and enjoyable player experience

  • Analyze player behavior, game metrics, and level performance to identify opportunities for improvement

  • Combine creativity and data to iterate on existing levels and create new gameplay experiences

  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Game Developers, and Game Artists to bring levels and gameplay ideas to life

  • Playtest levels regularly and fine-tune them based on player behavior, data, and team feedback

  • Contribute new ideas for game mechanics, features, and level design improvements

  • Follow the puzzle and hybrid-casual market closely to understand emerging mechanics, trends, and player expectations

  • Contribute to improving our level design tools, workflows, and processes

YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field

  • 2+ years of experience in Level Design, Game Design, Product, or a similar role in the mobile gaming industry

  • Strong understanding of puzzle game mechanics, level progression, and difficulty balancing

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret game data and turn insights into design decisions

  • Good understanding of player behavior, engagement, and retention

  • Strong sense of gameplay experience with great attention to detail

  • Ability to rapidly test, iterate, and improve ideas based on data and feedback

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

About Bigger Games

At Bigger Games, we create engaging and innovative mobile games enjoyed by millions of players around the world. We are a passionate team driven by creativity, curiosity, and the ambition to build unforgettable gaming experiences.

We are looking for a curious, creative, and highly motivated Marketing Intern who shares our passion for mobile games and is eager to learn, contribute, and grow with us!

 

What You'll Do

  • Work closely with the Product and Performance Marketing teams across different projects.

  • Support creative ideation and production for our games and marketing campaigns.

  • Play, test, and analyze our games, providing feedback on gameplay, user experience, and potential improvements.

  • Support QA processes when needed and help identify bugs and usability issues.

  • Research market trends, competitor games, and high-performing ad creatives to identify new opportunities.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Currently pursuing a university degree and available to work at least 3 days per week from our office.

  • Strong knowledge of mobile games and the gaming industry, especially hybrid casual games.

  • A solid understanding of game mechanics, player experience, and what makes games engaging.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • A creative and curious mindset with a willingness to explore new ideas.

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to learn and take initiative.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

 

What We Offer

  • Meal and transportation allowance

  • Flexible working hours around your university schedule

  • Opportunity for a full-time role after graduation

  • Team events and social activities

  • Hands-on experience in the mobile gaming industry

  • All the tools and equipment you need to do your best work

  • PS5 and gaming corner to unwind and enjoy your favorite games

  • Modern office in the heart of Istanbul

 

Previous experience in gaming or marketing is not required. What matters most to us is your passion for games, curiosity, and eagerness to learn!

 

Follow Bigger Games on Linkedin

We respect your privacy and will treat your data confidential as part of the recruitment process. If you’d like more details, please read our Statement of Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK) and Consent Letter.
